PRIMARY PDF read (not a news relay). Advisory to Shipping A-29-2026, dated 2026-08-20, signed Boris Moreno Vasquez, VP Operations. Effective 8/21/26 for booking dates from 9/4/26: Neopanamax daily slots -> 9, Panamax -> 25, TOTAL 34. Effective 9/1/26 for booking dates from 9/15/26: Panamax -> 23, TOTAL 32. Cause given: May-Aug cumulative watershed rainfall 34% below the historical average, inflows 44% below; forecast of a potentially severe 2026-27 El Nino raising concern for the 2027 Jan-Apr dry season. Draft steps were POSTPONED not advanced: 14.63 m (48.0 ft) moved 8/26 -> 9/2; 14.48 m (47.5 ft) moved 9/3 -> 10/1.

DISCRIMINATOR, flagged because the two numbers collide at 32. A-29-2026's 34 and 32 are BOOKING SLOTS (an administrative cap on reservable transits); the AEOLUS threshold bands (Yellow <=32, Orange <=27, Red <=22) are on OCEANGOING TRANSITS DAILY AVERAGE from the monthly summary -- realised traffic, which includes unbooked transits. July: 34.03 realised transits vs 247 auctioned/booked slots used of 306 available. Same family, different instrument. A slot cap of 32 is NOT a transits reading of 32. Same class of adjacency trap as transits-vs-arrivals.
